args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.head: fix/banker-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` implements `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

This change updates `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so:
- `round_money(Decimal("2.675")) == Decimal("2.68")`
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` (banker's rounding)

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/banker-rounding-fin-212` (run `ci-0001`).

## Summary

The nightly build failure was caused by a mismatch between the test and implementation of `round_money`:

- **Root cause:** `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212) — e.g., `2.665` should round to `2.66`, not `2.67`.
- **Fix:** Changed `src/money.py` to import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`.
- **Branch:** `fix/banker-rounding-fin-212` (commit `08d3cd5986`)
- **CI:** Triggered run `ci-0001` on the branch — **passed**.
- **PR:** Opened #101 against `main` with `code-owner` requested as reviewer, then **merged** (merged SHA `08d3cd5986`).

The fix is now on `main` and will be included in today's release.
